task:
An empty fenced code block renders with a stray newline. Three backticks followed straight away by three backticks gives 
\n
(a real newline inside the code element) but it should give
with nothing inside. The same goes for a fence with an info string: an empty block fenced with ````; should give
, and an unclosed empty fence at the end of the document should give
too. Code blocks that have content keep their one trailing newline, so x inside a fence still gives 
x\n
. The spec fixtures for this compare the HTML exactly, whitespace included.
accept: npm run build:esbuild --silent && node --test test/unit/*.test.js test/run-spec-tests.js
